mapper.sql: m.id, f.id factory_id, f.owner_user_id owner_id, f.factory_name, m.applyment_id, m.sub_mchid, COALESCE(m.subject_name_snapshot, f.factory_name) subject_name, COALESCE(m.account_status, 'not_applied') account_status, COALESCE(m.profit_sharing_status, 'unavailable') profit_sharing_status, m.channel_status_snapshot_json, m.last_synced_at, COALESCE(m.version, 0) version, m.onboarding_request_no
FROM factory_profile f LEFT JOIN factory_wechat_merchant_account m ON m.factory_id=f.id
mapper.update: UPDATE factory_wechat_merchant_account SET applyment_id=#{sync.applymentId}, onboarding_request_no=#{sync.requestNo}, sub_mchid=COALESCE(#{sync.subMchid}, sub_mchid), account_status=#{sync.accountStatus}, profit_sharing_status=#{sync.profitSharingStatus}, channel_status_snapshot_json=#{sync.snapshot}, last_synced_at=#{sync.now}, verified_at=CASE WHEN #{sync.accountStatus}='active' THEN COALESCE(verified_at, #{sync.now}) ELSE verified_at END, version=version+1, updated_at=#{sync.now} WHERE id=#{sync.id} AND version=#{sync.version}
